rv.q: Directed by Jade Lewis with a sure sense of rhythm, Superhoe is smart, sweary, authentic and provocative.
The beauty of the super-smart Superhoe is that it makes you feel all this generational angst on the pulse.

rv.q: Still, it's a terrific 90 minutes of entertainment... the ambition – and the results – are undeniably impressive.
Nicôle Lecky is a serious name to watch.
Though rarely surprising, it's a simple story strongly told, asking important questions about what we teach young girls they are worth.

cn.t: Lecky's one-woman show about a struggling young musician is an astute, engaging exploration of financial precarity, social media facades, and sex work, though flawed. Critics see serious promise in her multi-talented performance.
